summary: # Clo User Story – Calida ## Introduction Calida, for me, is high-quality, super comfy, and well-fitting underwear, nightwear, and loungewear. I’m Fabienne Meurie, and I’m leading the technical product development team at Calida. Our team consists of pattern makers and a 3D developer. ## Implementation of 3D Workflows At the beginning of 2021, we set up workarounds and workflows in our company using 3D across different departments. This included hollows, packaging, visual merchandising guidelines, and more. ## Transition to CLO3D Before we implemented CLO3D, I always had to wait for the sewn samples to see if my pattern was good and if I had placed the right lines, and so on. Now, I can create the pattern, bring it into CLO, and view it on the avatar to ensure everything is correct and in the right place. This transition has allowed me to save both samples and time, which is incredibly beneficial. ## Interdepartmental Collaboration The integration of CLO3D has resulted in closer, even new collaborations between different departments, such as technical product development with the design team and the visual merchandising team, which we didn’t have before. ## Developing the Kids Collection Another benefit of using CLO3D is for developing the kids' collection. I can easily place motif prints and check the size or rise placement at the right position. This process has made it much clearer for everyone involved, including the design process and the sales team. ## Advantages in Visual Merchandising The benefits we've seen from implementing CLO3D in relation to visual merchandising include increased speed. Combinations or changes can be made quickly in 3D, which allows us to save money and reduce the effort required to order items that we might not use for the window displays. ## Future Plans We are continuing to build up our libraries and perfect them. Our goal is to have our entire collection represented in 3D. I truly believe that 3D is and will be the future of garment manufacturing. ## Conclusion We are really happy with the support from CLO3D and grateful for the advancements it has brought to our processes.
